name: TypeScript API Client Module
description: Creates a typed TypeScript API client module with functions for each endpoint, using a shared fetch helper. Follows a consistent pattern: function per endpoint, typed request/response, error propagation.

parameters.name: moduleName
parameters.description: Name of the module/file (e.g. connections, stageConfig)

parameters.name: fetchHelper
parameters.description: Name of the existing fetch helper function to use (e.g. apiFetch)

parameters.name: endpoints
parameters.description: JSON array of endpoint descriptors: [{name, method, path, requestType, responseType, description}]

parameters.name: importTypes
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of types to import from types module (e.g. Connection, ConnectionInput, TestResult)
